_note: Curated news sources. Nothing is polled until a source has active true, terms_checked true and a terms_url. Feeds below were probed on 2026-10-31 (HTTP 200, valid XML, recent items, robots.txt allows the path); terms_checked is true only after someone has read the outlet's terms for feed reuse (non-commercial use, headline + short excerpt + link only). The relevance filter in data/news_keywords.json (air quality from anywhere, plus Jakarta protests and closures) runs before any model call; set relevance_filter false on a source to switch it off. store_excerpt false means only the headline and link are kept.
